heard: In 1977, Earth detected a mysterious signal from space. It lasted just 72 seconds, then, I'd vanished.
A radio telescope in Ohio had picked up something extraordinary, a powerful, narrow radio signal, unlike the usual background noise.
When a strong or Jerry Aemon examined the data, he circled six strange characters. And wrote just one word. Wow!
The signal appeared to come from the direction of Sagittarius. Near a frequency scientist had considered promising for communication across space. Was someone trying to contact Earth?
Scientists search for it again and again, but the signal never returned. Some researchers now suspect a natural cosmic event.
Nearly 50 years later, its exact cause remains unconfirmed. So what did Earth detect for those 72 seconds?
